reviews.conclusion: Five pause/options/controls visits are visible, totaling approximately 5.0-7.5 s in sampled bounds. This is compatible at the upper edge with the -7.5 s deficit, but horizontal reductions obscure two additional phases and prevent an exact accounting. No isolated unexplained edit is established.
Terrain loading is followed by two visible pause/settings visits spanning approximately 2.0-3.0 s in total, compatible with the 2.5 s deficit.
End terrain loading is immediately followed by settings screens lasting approximately 1.75-2.25 s, compatible with the 2.0 s deficit.
After portal terrain loading, an options/video-settings visit and another brief options visit total approximately 1.5-2.5 s, compatible with -1.9667 s.

Across this longer bastion bracket, two brief pause/options visits total approximately 0.75-1.75 s, compatible with -1.4333 s. The remaining frames show looting, inventory use, trading and nether movement; inventory time is not automatically counted as a pause.

coverage.interpretation: Evidence-span interpolation between events in resolved, nonambiguous segments; not proof of continuity throughout those spans or the whole video. Matching heart modes are inference alternatives, not observed heart states.
